note: Subjects for the STAR FILES reels. A wikidata id resolves to that entity's P18 photo on Wikimedia Commons, which is the same path the app takes for celebrity portraits (see app/utils/wikimediaImage.ts), so the licence is nameable and the birth date on the slate comes off the same record as the face. manual:true means no free photo exists and the file has to be dropped into photos/ by hand; until it is, the template renders the redacted plate instead.

abhishek-sharma.why: Q19803999 has no P18 and the en-wiki article has no lead image, so there is no freely licensed photo of him anywhere on Commons as of 18 Sept 2026. Drop a licensed photo at photos/abhishek-sharma.jpg and re-render. Re-run `python3 genphotos.py --find "abhishek sharma"` in a few months; a player this size gets a Commons photo eventually, and flipping manual to false picks it up automatically.
